Global Economic Outlook and Industry Overview The global economy last year witnessed a gradual recovery from both the pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine war. China’s reopened economy seems to be rebounding firmly and the supply chain disruptions are unwinding, while dislocations to energy and food markets caused by the Russia-Ukraine war are receding. However, the inflation across major economies remains very high with the US & UK inflation already hitting at a four-decade high.
